messages:
Elaine (Sales): Hey team — HarbourCo legal asked for the minimal compliance bundle to unblock the Dedicated POC. They specifically asked for: SOC 2 attestation summary (not full report), pen-test confirmation/letter, network diagram for staging, and an example of our crypto key flow. Can we scope what we can hand over without full reports?
Omar (Security): We can provide: SOC2 cover letter + scope excerpt, signed pen-test letter (from our vendor) stating last test date and contact; network diagram sanitized for staging; and KMS key flow diagram with redacted ARNs. Need to confirm whether they require full pen-test findings or just attestation.
Jess (Solutions): I can assemble a "POC assurance pack" zip with those artifacts. Question: do we redact customer-specific hostnames and replace with placeholders? Also, HarborCo asked about whether Dedicated increases time-to-ship/price — need a line item for SOW.
Elaine (Sales): Yes redact. They asked for "evidence suitable for procurement" — prefer short, signed docs. Also include answer re: pricing delta for Dedicated vs hosted.
Ryan (Engineering): For Dedicated: spinning a staging pool in their VPC + KMS integration is ~5 business days after contract. If they want on-prem images it's longer. Also we'll need a temporary staging creds spec (no prod keys). I can provide anonymized logs and an example systemd unit for the service if that helps.
Omar (Security): Policy notes: pen-test letter we provide must include scope (in-scope hostnames redacted), date of test, vendor signature, and a statement about remediation windows. If HarbourCo insists on raw findings we need a signed NDA and escalation path.
Jess (Solutions): Draft checklist I'll use: 1) SOC2 cover letter (PDF) 2) Pen-test attestation letter (signed) 3) Sanitized staging network diagram (PNG + SVG) 4) KMS/key flow diagram (PNG) 5) Staging creds template + runbook excerpt (MD) 6) Short FAQ on dedicated pricing and timelines (MD). ETA 3 business days for the pack if Security approves redaction template.
Elaine (Sales): Perfect. HarborCo procurement gave us a deadline of EOD +5 business days. Can we hit that?
Omar (Security): 3 business days to prepare docs + 1 day for legal sign-off on the pen-test letter. If nothing else blocks we can meet EOD +4. Need confirmation on whether to include the last full pen-test date (we usually include it).
Elaine (Sales): Include the last test date. They also asked if we have an ISO summary excerpt — can we include a short statement of scope (not full ISO files)?
Omar (Security): Yes — provide ISO scope excerpt and evidence index (list of available artifacts). Do not attach full ISO docs unless PR/Legal approves.
Jess (Solutions): I'll start assembling and will upload to a presigned S3 link. Example upload path I'll use: s3://redwood-evidence/harbourco/poc-1739999999/ (I'll share presigned links to docs).
Ryan (Engineering): FYI deploy-bot: staging pool creation job queued.
deploy-bot: Job #4621 queued: create-dedicated-staging-pool (owner: Ryan). Estimated run: ~6h.
Elaine (Sales): Great. I'll tell HarbourCo procurement we're targeting EOD +4 and will share presigned link when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
Omar (Security): Quick checklist for Jess: ensure pen-test attestation includes vendor contact; SOC2 cover letter includes effective date and auditor name; KMS flow shows separation of customer keys; network diagram replaces IPs with placeholders.
Jess (Solutions): Got it. I'll ping when the presigned link is ready and attach the FAQ line for Dedicated pricing.
Elaine (Sales): Thanks all — looping in Legal if they need to sign anything: @maria.
Jess (Solutions): Draft pack will be in the link: https://presigned.s3.redwood.internal/harbourco/poc-1739999999/pack.zip (will rotate keys before handing over).
Omar (Security): :+1: once uploaded I'll review and stamp approval.
Elaine (Sales): Fantastic — filing this as the HarbourCo POC compliance thread.
